settings.name_in_paper: Incentivized Exploration with Stochastic Rewards (Lipschitz bandits on a metric space with reward drift)
unmapped: Incentivized exploration: principal recommends arm, myopic agent picks greedy arm unless compensated by kappa_t = hat mu(g_t) - hat mu(a_t); total compensation is also an objective
Reward drift: observed reward r_t = rho_t(a_t) + gamma_t(kappa_t), gamma_t non-decreasing, gamma_t(0)=0, ell_t-Lipschitz (Assumption 1)
Arm space is a compact metric space with covering dimension d (A subset of [0,1]^d)
settings.definition_quote: We consider a variant of the multi-armed bandit problem with an uncountable set of arms $A$, structured as a metric space $(A, \Phi)$ ... its reward is independently drawn from a probability distribution supported on $[0,1]$ with mean $\mu(a)$ ... $|\mu(a) - \mu(a')| \leq L \cdot \Phi(a, a')$ ... modifying the observed reward to $r_t = \rho_t(a_t) + \gamma_t(\kappa_t)$

source.quote: Consider Algorithm~\ref{meta-inc-uniform} run on a metric space \((A, \Phi)\), where arms are discretized using a \(\psi\)-covering \(A_0 \subseteq A\) satisfying \(|A_0| \leq O(1 / \psi^d)\), with \(d\) denoting the covering dimension of \((A, \Phi)\).
